mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in nonfarm payrolls is negative for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Y-o-y PAYEMS negative for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Y-o-y PAYEMS negative for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST Y-o-Y growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth is negative year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening supply chain and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Y-o-y INDPRO negative for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO negative for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPI) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate is above 2%, it signals a high inflation environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y-o-Y growth > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is accelerating and the unemployment rate is falling, it signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 Y-o-Y growth accelerating and UNRATE falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
